radiusSource: Radius 0.999 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of EPIC 229004835 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract): 695,004 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5868 +/- 60 K from Bonomo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 229004835 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
